images.title: A stack of dots
images.purpose: Show the triangular number 10 as rows of 1, 2, 3 and 4 dots stacked into a triangle.
images.composition: One centred triangle of dots with the sum written below.
images.exact_structure: A triangle of exactly 10 equal dots in 4 centred rows from top to bottom of 1, 2, 3 and 4 dots, evenly spaced, the rows alternately teal #0072B2 and amber #E69F00. A thin grey #6B7280 triangle outline surrounds them. Below, centred, the sum. Exactly 10 dots, 4 rows, 1 outline.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a row with a wrong number of dots
images.takeaway: Adding the rows 1, 2, 3, 4 gives 10 dots in a triangle.
images.description: Ten dots in rows of 1, 2, 3 and 4 inside a triangle outline with the sum below.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count each row aloud and then add them.

image_decisions.why: A single stack and one sum keep the picture simple.
